tools.name: create_key
tools.description: Create a random PUBLIC key, absolute TTL (default one hour). No credentials returned; anyone knowing the ID can modify it.

tools.name: get_key
tools.description: Read exact string value, metadata and ETag. May renew sliding TTL with write access; refuses burn values.

tools.name: get_metadata
tools.description: Inspect metadata and ETag without reading values, renewing expiry or consuming burn keys.

tools.name: put_key
tools.description: Create or replace UTF-8 text. Existing protection remains; absolute deadlines cannot extend. Preconditions prevent lost updates.

tools.name: patch_key
tools.description: Apply JSON Merge Patch text with an exact quoted ETag. Null members delete; arrays/scalars replace. No blind retries.

tools.name: delete_key
tools.description: Permanently delete a key with write access and optional ETag. Missing keys return 404.

tools.name: touch_key
tools.description: Renew TTL with write access, within the existing absolute deadline. Never revive expired keys.

tools.name: increment_counter
tools.description: Atomically increment a signed 64-bit counter; optional clamps and bounded history. Never retry blindly.

tools.name: decrement_counter
tools.description: Atomically decrement a signed 64-bit counter; optional clamps and bounded history. Never retry blindly.

tools.name: get_counter_history
tools.description: Read opted-in UTC history: 168 hourly, 90 daily or 24 monthly buckets; ISO start inclusive/end exclusive.

tools.name: wait_for_change
tools.description: Wait up to 30 seconds for a visible change. Timeout is normal; no replay or burn values. Maximum two concurrent waits/IP.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_key" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Create a random PUBLIC key, absolute TTL (default one hour). No credentials returned; anyone knowing the ID can modify it.
